questions: Scope of supervision#r122. The line reads: "[r122] **When** `work run` checks a work-item against the whole suite, `work run` shall count as expected to fail each scenario whose requirement a capability-proposal that is neither `formulated` nor `withdrawn` adds or changes." Readings: (a) the check is only the whole-suite run before a merge (r43, which r4 uses), so the line would say "runs the whole suite before a merge"; (b) the check is every whole-suite run for a work-item, the run before an implementer starts (r24) as well as the one before a merge (r43), as the line reads now. Recommended: (b), the line as drafted.
